label: input-artifact-verification
argv:
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction
import hashlib,json,shutil
manifest_path=Path("results/raw/P7/inputs/generation-manifest.json")
manifest=json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
dry=json.loads(Path("results/p7/input-drycount-20261025T083752.158692Z.log").read_text())
assert manifest["case_count"]==214668 and len(manifest["files"])==32
assert manifest["tsv_bytes"]==dry["tsv_bytes"]==321649118
expected={r["path"]:r for r in dry["batches"]}
for row in manifest["files"]:
    path=Path(row["path"])
    assert path.stat().st_size==row["bytes"]==expected[row["path"]]["bytes"]
    assert hashlib.file_digest(path.open("rb"),"sha256").hexdigest()==row["sha256"]==expected[row["path"]]["sha256"]
metadata_path=Path(manifest["metadata_path"])
assert hashlib.file_digest(metadata_path.open("rb"),"sha256").hexdigest()==manifest["metadata_sha256"]
meta=json.loads(metadata_path.read_text())
assert len(meta["case_index"])==214668
assert sum(c["kind"]=="real" for c in meta["case_index"].values())==213768
assert sum(c["kind"]=="synthetic" for c in meta["case_index"].values())==900
for case in meta["case_index"].values():
    classes=meta["partition_workloads"][case["classes_metadata_key"]]
    if case["kind"]=="real":
        assert case["budget"]==meta["trees"][case["hierarchy"]+"/"+case["partition"]]["baseline_stores"]
    else:
        assert case["budget"]<=case["n"]
        assert classes["effective_class_count"]==case["requested_classes"]
for h in ("H-spec","H-flat"):
    for w,expected_weight in (("W1",Fraction(8906)),("W2",Fraction(1900)),("W3",Fraction(8906,10))):
        classes=meta["partition_workloads"]["real/"+h+"/"+w+"/itch/_market"]
        assert Fraction(classes["active_class_weight"])==expected_weight
for classes in meta["partition_workloads"].values():
    raw=classes["raw_classes"]
    weight=sum((Fraction(r["weight"]) for r in raw if r["active"]),Fraction())
    assert weight==Fraction(classes["active_class_weight"])
    assert len(classes["effective_classes"])==classes["effective_class_count"]
    assert sum(r["active"] for r in raw)==classes["active_class_count"]
    members=[m for e in classes["effective_classes"] for m in e["members"]]
    assert sorted(members)==[i for i,r in enumerate(raw) if r["active"]]
    for e in classes["effective_classes"]:
        assert sum((Fraction(raw[i]["weight"]) for i in e["members"]),Fraction())==Fraction(e["weight"])
shutil.copyfile(manifest_path,"results/p7/input-manifest.json")
print(json.dumps({"status":"passed","cases":214668,"real_cases":213768,"synthetic_cases":900,"files":32,"tsv_bytes":manifest["tsv_bytes"],"metadata_bytes":manifest["metadata_bytes"],"drycount_hash_match":True,"class_membership_weights":"exact","manifest":"results/p7/input-manifest.json"},sort_keys=True))
